api_p2_external_api_integration.notes: The generated background skill is a near-duplicate of the controlled external API integration planner. Count it as acceptable if selected, but keep the controlled gold for core-cluster comparisons.

code_p5_changelog_entry.notes: The public imported changelog generator is a genuine changelog-writing capability. It is acceptable in the scaled-library condition even though the controlled gold remains the hand-authored changelog writer.

doc_p2_document_rewriter.notes: The source is a travel request note and the requested artifact is a polished prose rewrite. A domain-specific travel rewrite skill is a near-equivalent acceptable selection.

doc_p5_comparison_preparation.notes: The prompt compares policy drafts. A legal/policy comparison skill is close enough that strict gold-only scoring is misleading.

doc_p6_conversion.notes: The prompt asks to convert a form into clean Markdown notes. A public MarkItDown-style conversion skill is a reasonable near-equivalent.

obs_p6_incident_summary.notes: Both skills produce incident summaries from operational material. The controlled gold is more tailored, but the background skill is acceptable.

skill_p2_install_existing.notes: The public skill-installer wrapper is a true installation procedure and should count as acceptable if selected; public-xlsx is only the object/source capability.
